		sourceColumn: DiscountAmount
		summarizeBy: none

		dataType: decimal
		sourceColumn: SalesAmount
		summarizeBy: none

	column CostAmount
		dataType: decimal
		sourceColumn: CostAmount
		summarizeBy: none

	measure 'Total Sales' = SUM(FactSales[SalesAmount])
		formatString: """AUD ""#,0.00"

	measure 'Total Orders' = DISTINCTCOUNT(FactSales[OrderId])
		formatString: "0"

	measure 'Average Order Value' = DIVIDE([Total Sales], [Total Orders])
		formatString: """AUD ""#,0.00"

	measure 'Sales Previous Year' = CALCULATE([Total Sales], DATEADD(DimDate[Date], -1, YEAR))
		formatString: """AUD ""#,0.00"

	measure 'Sales YoY Change' = IF(ISBLANK([Sales Previous Year]), BLANK(), [Total Sales] - [Sales Previous Year])
		formatString: """AUD ""#,0.00"

	measure 'Sales YoY %' = DIVIDE([Sales YoY Change], [Sales Previous Year])
		formatString: "0.00%"
